name: William Pestle
summary: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, William Pestle gathers supplies for Stormwind's apothecary. He and his brother Morgan run the shop in the Trade District, and William hires travelers to find candles, kelp, and herbs.

sections.title: Apothecary Abroad
sections.body: William works from Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn while his brother Morgan Pestle tends the counter at Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind City's Trade District. From Elwynn Forest, William works with local gatherers to secure raw materials the city shops need. He sends regular shipments to the capital, where Stormwind's citizens rely on a steady supply of restorative salves, draughts, and powders.

sections.title: Curious Reagents
sections.body: William often needs more than common garden herbs for his craft. He hires newcomers to gather wax candles carried by Elwynn's kobolds and crystal kelp from the murlocs of Crystal Lake, just east of Goldshire. The ingredients may seem strange to those unfamiliar with alchemy, but William believes they have potent virtues in a mixture.

sections.title: A Concoction for Young Love
sections.body: William is an old friend of Mildred Stonefield. When Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield are caught between their families' bitter feud, William agrees to brew an Invisibility Liquor. Made with kelp gathered from local waters, the brew lets Maybell slip away unseen to meet Tommy Joe.

faq.answer: William Pestle is an alchemist who works from the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. He and his brother Morgan gather and prepare supplies for the apothecary in Stormwind City.

faq.q: Where can William Pestle be found?
faq.answer: William Pestle can be found inside the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What does William do with kobold candles?
faq.answer: William gathers wax candles carried by kobolds in Elwynn's mines, then melts them and refines the tallow for alchemical mixtures and the apothecary's stock.

faq.q: Why does William need Crystal Kelp?
faq.answer: William uses Crystal Kelp from local Elwynn lakes to make an Invisibility Liquor. It helps Maybell Maclure slip past her family to meet Tommy Joe Stonefield.

faq.q: What is William Pestle's connection to Stormwind City?
faq.answer: William and his brother Morgan run the apothecary in Stormwind City's Trade District. William gathers ingredients in Goldshire and sends shipments to the city shop.

faq.q: How is William involved with the Stonefields and Maclures?
faq.answer: William is an old friend of Mildred Stonefield. He brews a covert drink to help Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure get around their families' bitter feud.

angles.text: As an herbalist in Goldshire, you can see how plant gathering serves William's trade. He turns wild growth and strange aquatic kelp into useful mixtures.
William helps supply Stormwind's Trade District with medicines and other goods. He depends on Alliance recruits passing through Goldshire to gather materials from the surrounding forest.
